recipes.name: Bitterballen (Dutch meatballs)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52979. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Melt the butter in a skillet or pan. When melted, add the flour little by little and stir into a thick paste. Slowly stir in the stock, making sure the roux absorbs the liquid. Simmer for a couple of minutes on a low heat while you stir in the onion, parsley and the shredded meat. The mixture should thicken and turn into a heavy, thick sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Pour the mixture into a shallow container, cover and refrigerate for several hours, or until the sauce has solidified.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Take a heaping tablespoon of the cold, thick sauce and quickly roll it into a small ball. Roll lightly through the flour, then the egg and finally the breadcrumbs. Make sure that the egg covers the whole surface of the bitterbal. When done, refrigerate the snacks while the oil in your fryer heats up to 190C (375F). Fry four bitterballen at a time, until golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve on a plate with a nice grainy or spicy mustard.

recipes.name: Kapsalon
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52769. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut the meat into strips. Heat oil in a pan and fry the strips for 6 minutes until it's ready.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Bake the fries until golden brown in a deep fryrer. When ready transfer to a backing dish. Make sure the fries are spread over the whole dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover the fries with a new layer of meat and spread evenly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add a layer of cheese over the meat. You can also use grated cheese. When done put in the oven for a few minutes until the cheese is melted.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Chop the lettuce, tomato and cucumber in small pieces and mix together. for a basic salad. As extra you can add olives jalapenos and a red union.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Dived the salad over the dish and Serve with garlicsauce and hot sauce

recipes.name: Stamppot
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52980. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Wash and peel the potatoes and cut into similarly sized pieces for even cooking.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In a large soup pot, boil the potatoes and the bay leaves in salted water for 20 minutes. Discard the bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: If you're not using a bag of ready-cut curly kale, wash the bunches thoroughly under cool running water to get rid of all soil—you wouldn't want that gritty texture in your finished dish. Trim any coarse stems and discard any brown leaves. With a sharp knife, cut the curly kale into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Peel and chop the shallots.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: In a frying pan or skillet, melt 1 tbsp. of butter and saute the shallots for a few minutes before adding the curly kale and 2 tbsp. of water. Season and cook for about 10 minutes, or until tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Warm the milk on the stove or in the microwave.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Drain, shake and dry the potatoes with kitchen towels before mashing with a potato masher or ricer. Working quickly, add the warm milk and the remaining butter. Season to taste with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Mix the cooked curly kale through the cooked mashed potato mixture.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Top with slices of the smoked sausage and serve hot with your favorite mustard or gravy.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Serve and enjoy!
